visual.description: Centered headline spanning ~80% width with subtitle below it, single CTA button, then a product screenshot mockup at the bottom half bleeding off-screen.
Product UI screenshot occupies left ~65% of viewport while a second image occupies right ~35%, both inside a rounded card frame.
Single centered text block spanning ~60% width, no columns, no images — pure typographic section.
8 company logos arranged in 2 rows of 4 equal columns.
Left ~45% contains a vertically stacked list of feature items; right ~55% shows a product screenshot.
Four feature tiles in a 2-column, 2-row equal grid.
Three feature tiles in a single row of 3 equal columns.
Three columns of testimonial cards with varied heights (masonry-style).
Five labeled columns with link lists and an update card.
